title: Test-driven development
summary: Specify behavior as a failing test, make it pass with the smallest change, then clean up, one behavior at a time.

provenance.notes: In this runtime the test file is frequently immutable for the worker (an Oracle); the workflow therefore also covers writing tests as a separate, reviewed task.

inputs.name: test-policy
inputs.description: Whether the test file may be edited or is an immutable oracle.

outputs.name: tests
outputs.description: A test per acceptance criterion, observed failing then passing.

outputs.name: change
outputs.description: The smallest implementation that passes them.

workflow.step: Turn each acceptance criterion into one test-sized behavior with a concrete input and expected output.
If the test file is immutable, treat the existing tests as the specification and do not edit them; otherwise write the failing test first.
workflow.check: The test policy was read before editing.

workflow.step: Run the test and confirm it fails for the right reason (missing behavior, not a typo).
workflow.check: The failure message names the missing behavior.

workflow.step: Implement the least code that passes; avoid anticipating later criteria.
workflow.check: The diff adds nothing that no test requires.

workflow.step: Refactor only with tests green, then rerun the verifier.

constraints: Never weaken or delete a test to get to green.
A worker that may not edit tests must report a wrong test as a finding.
Coverage numbers are not a goal; behavior is.

examples.title: Boundary criterion
examples.situation: Acceptance says inputs over 100 are rejected.
examples.guidance: Write rows for 100 and 101, watch 101 fail, add the check, watch both pass.

verification: A new test failed before the change and passes after it.
No test was edited or removed when the policy forbids it.

task.text: Use tdd: add the new behavior with a failing test first against the acceptance criteria.
Plan the work as red green with a regression test for each acceptance criteria.
Review the tdd failing test approach.
